Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.594 of 2023 dated 7th May 2023 registered with
Hinjewadi Police Station, District Pune for offences punishable under sections 381, 404, 406, 420 of
the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant is seeking relief under section 438 of the Criminal
Procedure Code, 1973.
Prima facie, it appears that there is registered will executed by testator in favour of the applicant.
The withdrawal of the amount and taking away of gold ornaments from locker and other allegations need to be investigated by the applicant.
The aggrieved persons have their legal remedies available to challenge the registered will deed executed in favour of the applicant.
However, based on averment in recitals in the registered will deed, it appears that the owner of the property had bequeath substantial properties in favour of the applicant.
As regard rest of the properties in relation to the allegations made in the F.I.R., it is for the investigating agency to investigate into it and bring on record the correct position.
However for that purpose, at this stage, custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required.
Moreover, at the stage of final hearing of the present application, the issue of grant of final relief can be considered based on material made available by the investigating agency.

Hence, following order:
a) Till next date, in the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with C.R. No.594 of 2023 dated 7 th May 2023 registered with Hinjewadi Police Station, District Pune for offences punishable under sections 381, 404, 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, he be released on interim bail on furnishing PR Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- along with one or two sureties in the like amount.

b) The applicant shall remain present before the investigating officer on 24th, 26th and 28th July 2023 between 11:00 a.m. to 02:00 p.m. 917-aba1999-2023.doc c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any witness acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer.
d) The applicant shall not obstruct or hamper the police investigation and not to play mischief with the evidence collected or yet to be collected by the police.

e) The applicant shall, at the time of execution of the bond, furnish his address and mobile number to the investigating officer, and the court concerned, and shall not change the residence till the final disposal of the case.
3. Stand over to 11th August 2023.
(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
